subject: Attending CVPR | quick coffee?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Assuming you and the [COMPANY] team will be in Nashville for CVPR this year? Would be great to get a coffee and swap notes on the work we're doing in computer vision / multimodal model dev. 

If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

We'll be at the conference so let me know when works best for you and I can get it booked in! Feel free to swing by our booth (#1123) as well.

subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

If you're around for CVPR, I'd love to personally invite you to a small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat featuring Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, now Chief R&D Officer at Nexar), followed by a relaxed dinner and conversation with guests from Captions, Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robot, and other leading AI/ML teams.

Here are the details:
Date & Time: Saturday, June 14 at 6:30 PM Location: Moto Cucina (a 15-minute walk from the CVPR venue) Guests: A select group of ~20 CTOs, Heads of AI, and Founders from top AI teams. Confirmed attendees include leaders from Captions, Woven by Toyota, and Pickle Robot. This is an invite-only event for Encord partners and selected AI/ML scale-ups - we hope for it to be a relaxed evening for exchanging ideas, not a sales pitch. If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

Would you be interested in joining us?
